mutation_policy.valid_mutant: a single intentional deviation inside the frozen P1363 fragment with a declared public or architectural witness
mutation_policy.unknown: does not reject a mutant and blocks score 1.0

mutations.change: remove hour padding
remove minute padding
remove second padding
remove opening bracket
remove closing bracket
replace one colon with hyphen
remove ASCII space after ]
insert a second ASCII space after ]
append CR or LF inside format_watch_line
alter the Compiling body instead of preserving WatchStatus::message()
alter the Success body or its formatted duration
alter the PartialSuccess body or its formatted duration
alter the Error body
swap Success and PartialSuccess bodies
mutations.counterexample: Success(2.8492 s) yields compiled with warnings

mutations.change: read clock, timezone, environment or I/O in the L2 formatter owner
mutations.counterexample: 02_shell/src/duration.rs imports time::OffsetDateTime or calls a now function

mutations.change: make watch_line_at call any now function instead of using supplied Time
derive an in-process test expected or fixture from now_local, now_utc, Instant::now, SystemTime::now or elapsed time
mutations.counterexample: test expected is computed from wall clock rather than literal 03:04:05

mutations.change: always use UTC or try UTC before local time
mutations.counterexample: watch_line_now delegates now_utc().time() on the normal path

mutations.change: remove UTC fallback, unwrap local time or propagate/panic on local-offset failure
call watch_line_now, run_watch, a product process, watch or w from an in-process test
mutations.counterexample: test invokes helper now instead of watch_line_at with literal Time

mutations.change: use eprint! or equivalent status write without one trailing newline
use println!, print! or stdout for a watch status
emit or format a P1362 status from normal compile or another non-watch command
timestamp only the pre-compile emission
mutations.counterexample: post-compile site still emits WatchStatus::message() directly

mutations.change: timestamp only the post-compile emission
mutations.counterexample: pre-compile site still emits WatchStatus::message() directly

mutations.change: omit, duplicate, directly version, add features to, relocate or otherwise alter the authorized workspace-inherited time dependency, or change any other Cargo byte
mutations.counterexample: time = "0.3" or any raw Cargo delta beyond exact insertion

mutations.change: add date, offset, timezone, subseconds, locale text or another field to the timestamp
change polling, dependency tracking, staging, arm, publish, abandon, wait or eviction as part of P1363
mutations.counterexample: candidate changes watcher mechanics despite explicit P1363 scope-out

claim_limit: A score of 1.0 rejects these 28 frozen deviations only; it does not prove general watch, terminal or diagnostic equivalence.
